Silver Arrows.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found {{item}}. They're very powerful, and {{player}} needs them to give Ganon his last moment. Good luck!

Silver Bow.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found a Bow with Silver Arrows. They're very powerful, and {{player}} needs them to give Ganon his last moment. Good luck!

Book of Mudora.merchantPre: This is {{player}}'s {{item}}. It appears to be some sort of language translation guide. I don't understand the symbols in it, but maybe they will.

Hammer.forgePost: I made a strong {{item}} for {{player}}. I went outside to test it, and knocked someone's fence into the ground! Whoops...

Flute.sorceressPre: That's a {{item}}. Whenever I play it, a duck starts chasing me! I have no use for it. For {{count}} lollipops, I can give it to {{player}}.

Pegasus Boots.merchantPre: These are {{player}}'s {{item}}. They have a nice red color, and I feel like I could go running in them.
Pegasus Boots.sorceressPre: These are {{player}}'s {{item}}. They will let them run much faster!

Mushroom.sorceressPre: This {{item}} is for my friend, the witch in {{player}}'s world. She needs it to craft an item. Unfortunately, multiworld shipping costs are expensive, so I will need you to help me cover the {{count}} lollipop fee.
Mushroom.sorceressPost: Thanks! Make sure {{player}} delivers the {{item}} safely.

Magic Powder.sorceressPre: I made this {{item}} for {{player}}, using a recipe that I learned from a friend. I'll send it to them for {{count}} lollipops!

Moon Pearl.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test and found the {{item}}. {{player}} can use this to enter the other half of their world. Good luck!
Moon Pearl.merchantPre: This is {{player}}'s {{item}}. It would probably look amazing in a rock collection. {{count}} candies for this beautiful gem.
Moon Pearl.sorceressPre: That's {{player}}'s {{item}}. It is a powerful artifact that resists shapeshifting magic.

Bottle.sorceressPre: That's {{player}}'s {{item}}. It can hold many things, such as potions or small creatures.

Master Sword.forgePost: I found this {{item}} one day. I fixed it up, and now I feel it's ready to be wielded by {{player}}.

Tempered Sword.forgePost: I spent hours perfecting this {{item}} for {{player}} to wield. I'm sure they'll be glad to get it.

Fighter Sword.forgePost: Thanks for buying! This {{item}} is a bit weak, but it's better than having no sword at all.

Golden Sword.forgePost: This is as good as it gets. I cannot make a sword better than this {{item}}. Now, {{player}} can use it to save the day!
Golden Sword.merchantPre: This is a very deadly looking stick of butter. {{player}} might be able to put it to good use!

Progressive Sword.forgePost: I spent some time upgrading {{player}}'s sword. It should be a lot stronger now!

Triforce.merchantPre: This is {{player}}'s {{item}}. It looks very important. You should probably buy it for them. Only {{count}} candies!
Triforce.sorceressPre: That's {{player}}'s {{item}}. It's a legendary artifact which they need in order to save the land.

Single Bomb.merchantPre: This is a {{item}} for {{player}}. You want it? It's yours, my friend, as long as you have enough candies.
